stemMd: A steady current of 0.2 A flows for 3 minutes. How much charge passes a point?
explanationMd: Charge equals current times time. Convert 3 minutes to 180 seconds, then multiply by 0.2 coulombs per second to obtain 36 C.

distractorRationale.a: This divides time in minutes by current.
distractorRationale.e: This uses time alone as charge.
